title: Holding session and deadline recipe

holding_policy_id.description: implemented strategy horizon profile. No universal intraday cutoff for every strategy

maximum_hold_seconds.description: required when profile uses elapsed duration;integer>0. Not a market-open assumption

session_calendar_id.description: verified product/venue calendar plus broker exceptions. Holidays DST and special sessions tested

overnight_allowed.description: cannot exceed released account/product permission. Closing market can make stops dormant

product_deadline_policy_id.description: required for expiring/notice-sensitive products. Earliest applicable mandatory deadline wins

emergency_exit_recipe_id.description: qualified route urgency/quantity procedure. Unknown prior order prevents blind duplicate exit
